Tomas Rivera: Thanks for the all-hands — quick follow-up thread for the Q&A items that needed owners. Ill drop owners/links; please ack and add ETAs.

Elena M: Thanks Tomas. I'll take the public roadmap blurb updates. Need a short blurb per product line (API, Dedicated, Private). Drafting now, will post PR with copy.

Chris J: I'll own the Dedicated SLA appendix (contract-ready language + two latency buckets). Filing SLA-778 now. ETA Thurs.

Maya L: I'll coordinate the evals request from Product and collect prompt sets. Can Product drop canonical prompts into the redwood/evals folder?

eng-bot: Recording + slides -> https://drive.redwood.com/all-hands/jun-2026  Recording: https://redwood.zoom.us/rec/share/mnop3456

Elena M: Quick Q on public wording: do we mention specific P95 numbers publicly or keep them as "targets"?

Tomas Rivera: Keep public wording high-level ("target P95 latency under our published targets"). Reserve numeric P95s for contracts and the SLA appendix.

Chris J: Noted. Will include numeric buckets in SLA-778 and example public wording for Elena.

Maya L: Product please confirm priority models: chat gen > embeddings > rerank. Also confirm if canaries should run on pinned versions.

Tomas Rivera: Confirmed priorities and canary policy: pinned versions for canaries; production flips only after canary pass and manual signoff.

Elena M: I'll post the draft public blurb PR by Thu EOD.

Chris J: Ack. Adding fallback & rollback checklist to SLA-778.

Maya L: Ack. Will start populating eval prompts once Product posts them.

Tomas Rivera: Action summary: Elena -> public roadmap copy (PR by Thu); Chris -> SLA-778 numeric appendix + rollback checklist (Thu); Maya -> eval prompt collection (waiting on Product). Please add ETA or estimated hours in your ticket by Monday. Reply with :white_check_mark: when done.

Elena M: :white_check_mark: (PR up tomorrow)

Chris J: :white_check_mark:

Maya L: :white_check_mark: (will update when prompts in place)

Tomas Rivera: Thanks all. Closing this follow-up in 72h unless new questions come up. If anything critical, DM me or ping #product.
